newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak FinMin 26-week T-bill yield at 14.25 pct.
newsitem.headline: Slovak FinMin 26-week T-bill yield at 14.25 pct.

text.p: The net yield at the Slovak Finance Ministry auction of an unspecified tranche of 26-week treasury bills was.25 percent, the National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) said in a statement on Wednesday.
All the 73 million crowns worth of bids were accepted, it said. It gave no further details and ministry officials were not immediately available for comment.
The ministry rejected all bids, totalling 1.356 billion crowns, at a previous auction of 26-week T-bills on April 16.
The ministry does not set a limit price on bids in auctions of state securities, nor does it reveal amounts on offer.
